title: Need alpha testers for MMO i have been designing for over 20y.
author: Denaton_
selftext: Tried to share my game on IndieGaming, went as i would expected. I have over 25y of experience with programming and cant make 3D models, i have tried. I realized that if AI can make cool structures in Minecraft then it should be able to make nice looking things using similar tools. So i hooked it up to MagicaVoxel and setup an MCP for it. I made a colour pallet and rules for it to follow. I think they look great and i know this is a bit of a bubble sub, so please be honest, is it really that bad?
